minutes.headline: Green Communities Committee heard the state's program rep explain grant rules and agreed the Facebook page may post informational content.
minutes.summary: The committee, newly renamed from task force, met with a state Green Communities representative (Kelly) by Zoom, who explained the competitive grant, what projects qualify, deadlines, and new programs. Members discussed candidate projects (sewer pump stations, controls, mini splits, hot water, EV charging) and whether to apply in spring or fall. A motion allowing a member to post informational content on a committee Facebook page was voted, and the meeting adjourned.

votes.motion: Authorize the member to post content on the committee's Facebook page at her discretion, limited to informational content with no commenting.

budget_items.what_was_said: Interior lighting is still funded but only at reduced share and only at schools; no exterior or municipal LED upgrades.
New grants fund larger whole-building fossil-free projects with a municipal match, and make the town ineligible for a couple of years afterward.

budget_items.topic: Annual grant pool split between spring and fall blocks
budget_items.what_was_said: The state gives out a pool split between blocks, and unused spring money can shift to fall.

budget_items.topic: Energy Efficiency and Conservation Block Grants (federal)
budget_items.what_was_said: Smaller grants for towns under the population threshold will be announced in February, including seed funding for an energy manager.
The program funds charging stations up to a cap, but a project cannot take both this and the state EV incentive program.
A chair reported on a federal efficiency program for residents, with the state applying for a share.

budget_items.topic: Senior center hot water system upgrade in capital plan
budget_items.what_was_said: A capital plan line for the senior center hot water system was noted as a possible grant project, perhaps as electric instant hot water.
The town gets a per-vehicle grant for hybrid police cruisers, which could fill any remainder under the cap.

decisions.decision: The street light grant final report is due to the state the Friday after the meeting; the planning commission is finalizing it, which would make the town eligible for the spring block.
The chair will send the grant table to members and DPW to evaluate candidate projects such as sewer pump upgrades.
The next meeting is to be scheduled for late February or early March; the spring versus fall application question remains open, with a lean toward fall.
Content for the committee Facebook page may be shared by email for informal feedback beforehand, not approved at meetings; page stays informational with no commenting.
